About Us

Our customer’s satisfaction is our destination.

Sithara Exports is a South India based company engaged in export, trading and marketing of seafood and Indian agro products. We sit beside Aroor, the seafood city of Cochin, and act as sourcing agent for both buyers and sellers, connecting them with reliable shippers and packers.

Sourcing agent

Reliable shippers and packers, matched to your requirement.

Buyer-specific packing

Packed as per your packing requirements, every order.

Global inquiries

We welcome export inquiries and orders from all over the world.

Our Heritage

Three generations. One promise.

Since 1957, Sithara Exports has been a family business, and every shipment carries that name.

1957 – 1996
First generation · Founder

It all began in Chandiroor

Our grandfather, who worked in real estate, founded Sithara Exports and began exporting shrimp. When the business did well, he built a factory near the family home.

1996 onwards
Second generation

The next chapter

Our father took the business forward and explored beyond seafood, as Sithara reached buyers across the Middle East, Asia and parts of Europe.

Today
Third generation

Carrying the legacy ahead

The third generation steps forward with a modern approach and the same values: discipline, customer focus and being easy to work with.

The family lineage continues. Always aspiring, in every shipment.
The name
Sithara / aspiring star

“Sithara” means aspiring star, a name we have carried for three generations.

1957

From real estate to the sea

Before 1957, our grandfather worked in real estate. He then began exporting shrimp from Chandiroor, where Sithara Exports is still based today.

Chandiroor

A factory close to home

As the business did well, our grandfather built a factory in Chandiroor, near the family home. It remains our base, close to Aroor, the seafood city of Cochin.

1996

Beyond seafood

When our father took over, he explored beyond seafood. Today the range also covers meat, coconut, spices and Indian agro products.

Worldwide

Shipping across the world

Over the decades we have shipped to buyers in almost every part of the world, especially the Middle East and Asia, and to parts of Europe.

Middle EastAsiaEuropeAnd beyond

Disciplined

Our grandfather and our father both ran the business with discipline. We hold ourselves to the same standard.

Customer focused

Buyers have always come first. Our customer’s satisfaction is still our destination.

Easy to work with

Suppliers and buyers have always found us straightforward and easy to work with. We intend to keep that reputation.

The people behind the work

Some of the people who work with us have been with the family for many years. Their experience is part of every shipment we send.

A note from the third generation

My grandfather started Sithara Exports in 1957. In 1996 he handed it to my father, and today it is my turn to carry it forward.

I grew up knowing this name stands for something. Every shipment we send carries three generations of effort, and I take that seriously. Our promise to importers has not changed: honest dealings, packing the way you ask for it, and the same care from the first order to the hundredth.

Whether you have worked with us for years or are writing to us for the first time, I would be glad to hear from you personally.

Third generation, Sithara Exports
